subject: Implementation: model shortlist, context needs, and token ROI
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khanna <samir@lighthouse.ai>, Priya Rao <priya@lighthouse.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation kickoff — model shortlist, context needs, token ROI

Hi Samir / Priya,

Great to meet yesterday — looping in the CS/implementation leads here so we can get the model and sizing plan captured and agreed before the onboarding sprint. Summary of what we need to finalize this week: 

1) Model shortlist: constraints are latency <= 250ms P50 for single-turn completions, support for approximate 8k context (longer for a subset), and quantization-friendly variants for cost efficiency.
2) Context & token profile: your expected prompt lengths, average completion length, and peak/hour QPS so we can match batching/KV cache strategy.
3) Token ROI target: what’s an acceptable per-1M-token cost to stay within your FY28 unit economics? This will influence whether we start on a 7B quantized baseline vs 13B-quantized with more cache.

Deliverables attached: initial shortlist CSV and a simple token estimate workbook (see attachments). Please confirm the items below by EOD Wednesday so we can lock the canary plan: 
- Top 3 integrator endpoints (which APIs will see real traffic day 1)
- Expected request mix (chat vs single-turn vs embeddings)
- Typical prompt length and expected average completion length (tokens)
- Any regulatory constraints on context retention / caching

If easier, we can do a quick 30-min sync tomorrow.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com

From: Samir Khanna <samir@lighthouse.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Priya Rao <priya@lighthouse.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff — model shortlist, context needs, token ROI

Thanks Stephanie — helpful checklist. Quick answers below: 

- Day 1 endpoints: /assist (customer-facing chat), /summarize (batched document summaries), /classify (single-turn).
- Request mix: ~60% chat (/assist), 30% batch summarize (we'll call with multi-doc payloads), 10% classify/embeddings.
- Prompt length: average prompt ~180 tokens; completion average ~220 tokens. For /summarize some requests push 1k+ prompt tokens but are infrequent (~5% of traffic).
- Peak: expect ~1200 RPM (20 RPS) during peak business hours initially; we plan a phased ramp to 60 RPS over 3 months as we turn on additional customers.
- Compliance: we cannot persist full conversational history beyond 14 days; short-term KV caching for active sessions is fine if it's encrypted and auditable.

On ROI: current internal target is <$30 per 1M-generation tokens (post-quantization + caching). Open to tradeoffs if latency improves.

We can do a 30-minute sync tomorrow 11:00am PT to walk the specifics.

—Samir
Samir Khanna | Head of Platform 
Lighthouse.ai
(samir@lighthouse.ai)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 17:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: shortlist & sizing notes for Lighthouse.ai (do not forward)

Team — notes after Samir's answers and a quick pass through the CSV: 

- Preliminary model shortlist (ordered by recommended baseline -> premium):
  1) replacer-7b-q4f (7B quantized) — lowest cost, should hit ROI target with aggressive caching; expected to meet latency for /classify and /summarize but may struggle on 1k+ prompts for summarization quality.
  2) oak-13b-chat-q8 (13B chat-optimized, 8k context) — best tradeoff for chat quality and 8k context, still quantizable; requires slightly higher token cost but fewer retries.
  3) atlas-16k-13b-xt (13B extended context 16k) — keep as fallback for summarization-heavy jobs, more expensive but avoids truncation.

- Context strategy: enable prefix/KV caching for /assist sessions (14-day rolling cache but encrypted, per compliance). For /summarize, use transient windowing — send only the focused passage + metadata to reduce tokens.

- Cost assumptions used for rough token ROI:
  * replacer-7b-q4f: compute ~0.8 CPU/GPU token unit -> projected cost $22 / 1M gen tokens (with 40% effective caching for repeats).
  * oak-13b-chat-q8: projected cost $36 / 1M gen tokens (with 25% caching).
  * atlas-16k-13b-xt: projected cost $58 / 1M gen tokens (used only for 5% heavy summaries).

- Operational plan: start Canary on replacer-7b-q4f for non-critical traffic and /classify; baseline metrics for quality/latency over 2 weeks. If failure modes on summarization, bump to oak-13b-chat for /assist and use atlas only for explicit long-doc jobs.

I attached the internal playbook draft (implementation_playbook_v1.pdf) with suggested test prompts and checkpoints. I'll be on the sync tomorrow to walk through the bump criteria.

-Monica
Monica Patel | Lead, Customer Implementation | Redwood Inference
(attachment: implementation_playbook_v1.pdf (PDF))

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khanna <samir@lighthouse.ai>, Priya Rao <priya@lighthouse.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff — model shortlist, context needs, token ROI

Morning Samir / Priya — thanks for the detail and for the quick replies. Action items & plan we agreed on the call today: 

1) Canary plan (week 1-2):
   - Route 25% of traffic for /assist to replacer-7b-q4f (canary namespace) + run compare traffic to oak-13b-chat in A/B mode for quality sampling.
   - Metrics: latency P50/P95, generation token rate, 1% quality regression on NLU score, error/retry rate.
2) Summarization workflow:
   - For requests >2k prompt tokens, use atlas-16k-13b-xt path through a separate long-doc endpoint (explicit opt-in per call).
3) Token budget & ROI:
   - We'll target <$30 / 1M generation tokens overall via quantization + 30% effective caching. If observed >$35, we'll run a quick opt-in for a smaller model for /classify to reduce spend.
4) Compliance:
   - Implement encrypted, auditable KV caching with 14-day TTL. I'll share the compliance spec with your security team (Samir).

Next steps:
- Samir: confirm drive access and upload two representative large summarization payloads by EOD Friday.
- Priya: confirm ramp plan for new customers (timeline to 60 RPS).
- Monica/Grace/Ben: finalize canary runbook and checklists (we'll use the attached playbook).

Links and artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPlaybook (playbook + test prompts), HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/7821

I'll send a short A/B plan and rollout playbook after we get the sample payloads.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
